_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Bring 4 Venomtail Poison Sacs to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar.
Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost. At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south. Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
Bring 5 Singed Scales to Uzzek at Far Watch Post in the Barrens.
Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.
Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.
Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.
Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.
Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
Bring a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.
Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village. If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.
Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.
Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.
Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.
Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.
Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.
Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.
Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.
Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.
Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.
Find Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
Listen to what Ayessa Dawnsinger has to say.
Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the Windshapers are with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.
Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.
Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.
Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
Find Riaani Nightwind on the west side of Valanaar.
Gather 10 Wind Hollow Essences from Wind Hollows in the Shadowgale Forest.
Speak with Riaani Nightwind and listen to what he has to say.
Report back to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.
Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from the corpses of Al'Aketh cultists in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.
Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.
Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.
Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.
Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.
Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
Find and speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
Collect 8 Lady's Tear Moss.
Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.
Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.
Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.
Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and tell him what has transpired.
Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.
Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.
Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

quests.n: The Fate of a Loved One
quests.t: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.
Sit near Raan's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.
Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
Bring the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands.
Slay Skypriest Faladiel in the Gustberry Lowlands and collect Faladiel's Heart.
Find the home of Kuramaa in the Shen'dar Highlands, and defeat the spirit in combat. Bring Kuramaa's Mask to Olariaan Swiftburn in the Gustberry Lowlands when you are victorious.
Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions. You must deliver the Eternal Flame to Valanaar before the timer runs out.
